paragraphs: At the start of a shift, collect the work order and schematics and verify the vehicle's electrical configuration. Trace an intermittent circuit with an oscilloscope in the morning. Replace the module and reconnect the plug at midday. Apply power and test until every signal is green in the afternoon, then complete the maintenance record and sign the release.

This career combines practical ability, care, and systems awareness. Electrical power must remain stable, faults must be isolated accurately, and safety procedures must guide every decision in confined equipment bays.

This career develops persistence with electrical circuits. Workers must understand schematics and signals while patiently tracing faults in confined spaces. It suits practical, focused people who understand electrical systems and enjoy the moment every test indicator turns green.
Prefers practical, hands-on work and investigation (Realistic R + Investigative I + Conventional C).
